programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 16. december
programme.desc: I sine undersøgelser af familien Andersens forsvundne jul, er Julemand 39 kommet på sporet af den førtidspensionerede Julemand 68, som på mystisk vis lever i sus og dus på Bahamas.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 15. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har sporet Julemand 68, den sidste julemand, der har været hos familien Andersen, til Bahamas. Notarius har lovet at skaffe oplysninger , der kan bringe 68 hjem. Putte er ikke den julejomfru

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 14. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har endnu ikke fundet afgørende spor i efterforskningen af familien Andersens julehemmelig­hed. Og der er nogen, der har fjernet vigtige oplys­nin­ger i juleannalerne.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 13. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor vil familien Andersen ikke fejre jul? Julemand 39 har nu kun 11 dage tilbage til at løse mysteriet, ellers degraderer Julemandsrådet ham til nisse. Julemand 39 har bedt Notarius om at hjælpe sig med at finde Julemand 68

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 12. december
programme.desc: Hvor mange hemmeligheder har familien Andersen egentlig? Julemand 39’s opgave bliver vanskeligere og vanskeligere. Moster Karen har hemmeligheder for hele familien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 11. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor har familien Andersen ikke fejret jul i 19 år - eller er det 20? Skal svaret findes i kælderen? Julemand 39’s assistent, Frits, opdager, at Tage Andersen - efter at familien er gået til ro - lister ned i kælderen og låser døren efter sig.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 10. december
programme.desc: Den intetanende familien Andersen har taget godt imod Frits, der er forklædt som Åses bror Klavs fra Australien. Familien har det godt - bortset fra Putte, som savner sin gas- og vandmester.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 9. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet er ved at miste tålmodigheden med Julemand 39. I endnu et forsøg på at løse gåden om Andersens julefjendskhed har 39 sendt Frits ned til familien forklædt som Åse Andersens lillebror, onkel Klavs fra Australien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 8. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har kun 17 dage tilbage til at afsløre familien Andersens hemmelighed og få Tage, Åse og Putte til at hengive sig til juleriet. Han har stadig ingen spor at gå efter.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 7. december
programme.desc: Det er en særdeles vanskelig opgave Julemand 39 har fået af Julemandsrådet. Nu ved han ikke en gang, om det et 19 eller 20 år siden, familien sidst holdt jul.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: Fra John Travoltas fængslende og Oscarnominerede præstation til Bee Gees succes-soundtrack og de uforglemmelige dansetrin - "Saturday Night Fever" er en filmsensation, der fangede verdens opmærksomhed som aldrig før.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) løslades fra fængsel og tager et job hos sin indflydelsesrige onkel Frank (James Caan). Snart trækkes Leo uforvarende ind i en verden af sabotage, store bestikkelser og endda mord.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Baseret på Richard Yates' bestseller følger denne fængslende og gribende historie om et lidenskabeligt, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut, som bestemmer sig for at risikere alt og følge deres drømme.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Den talentfulde hasardspiller Michael har syv dage til at betale et større beløb til en skruppelløs virksomhed, eller han bliver likvideret. Han samler derfor et team af individer med overnaturlige evner for at score kassen på et kasino.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: Jake goes to prison to protect his friends and his best friend Chris turns his life around to become a police officer. When Jake is released after 15 years, he seeks revenge.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell
programme.desc: I år 2029 er en kvindelig cyberagent fra regeringen på sporet af "Dukkeføreren" - en computervirus, der er i stand til at invadere kybernetiske hjerner og ændre ofrenes hukommelse.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En tyv med en unik, professionel etik bliver bedraget af sin bande og efterladt til at dø. I en ny forklædning, og i en alliance med en kvinde, leder han efter bandens seneste udbytte fra et kup.

programme.title: Red Dawn

programme.title: Tokarev

programme.title: The Monster Squad

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen

programme.title: Henry Danger: Månestenen

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Phoebe vs Max

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Fjollet Fysikstævne

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: På Weekendbesøg

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Pjækkedag

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Det Går I Kludder

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Ubudne Restaurantgæster

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Forbryder I Nabolaget

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 15. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 14. december

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: The Other Woman
programme.desc: En hjertevarm film om kærlighed, sorg og forsoning med Natalie Portman i hovedrollen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman (Seven, Red, Batman Begins) kendt men aldrende skuespiller møder på sin research til en ny rolle en smuk spansk kassedame, der er mere end træt af sit job, som består i at servicere de kunder som har 10 eller færre varer.

programme.title: Familien Bélier
programme.desc: 16-årige Paula er tolk for sine døvstumme forældre og bror på daglig basis, specielt når det gælder driften af familiens landbrug. Da Paulas musiklærer opdager den unge piges helt særlige talent for at synge, opfordrer han hende straks til at melde sig...

programme.title: Final Target
programme.desc: Ava er en dødsensfarlig lejesoldat, der har højprofilerede lejemord som speciale. Men en opgave går galt, og hendes arbejdsgivere sender i al hemmelighed en lejemorder efter hende...

programme.title: Taken 3

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room

programme.title: Forår, sommer, efterår, vinter ... og forår
programme.desc: I en flydende eremitbolig midt i den koreanske vildmark guider en gammel munk en dreng gennem livets faser. Da drengen konfronteres med begær og vold, sættes hans visdom på prøve. En poetisk fortælling om balance, livscyklus og menneskelig indsigt.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: En Iskold Fødselsdag

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Drømmerejsen

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Pinligt Pyjamasparty

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Korkampen

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Er Der en Læge Til Stede?

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Far Som Superlærer
programme.desc: Hank bliver Max og Phoebes nye lærer i kemi, og da han spiser en af Phoebes sovesandwicher, falder han i søvn på jobbet, og tvillingerne må bruge deres kræfter for at han ikke skal blive fyret af rektor Bradford.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Fire Rødder og en Baby

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 5. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 4. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 3. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 24. december
programme.desc: I 23 dage har Julemand 39 nu efterforsket sandheden om hin juleaften for 19 år siden hos familien Andersen. Sammen med sin assistent, Frits, har han afsløret detalje på detalje, og han troede, at nu havde han fundet sandheden

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 23. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 22. december
programme.desc: Nu har julemand 39 samlet en vifte af oplysninger, der kan belyse mysteriet om den julefjendske familien Andersen. Putte er nisse - halvt nisse i hvert fald, og hun vil giftes med helnissen Frits, som på det groveste har drevet gæk med familien Andersen

programme.title: Dear Frankie

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear

programme.title: Fatal Instinct

programme.title: The Prince

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Fupkunstnere

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Max og Slaverne

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Partyforældre

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Pop og Papir

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Phoebe Er For Rå

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Elektrisk Fødselsdag
programme.desc: Phoebe og Max skal i Centeret for at hente Hanks fødselsdagsgave, men turen udvikler sig til slåskamp og kaos og et sammenstød med vagterne, der truer med at ødelægge deres fars fødselsdag.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Episk Fallerina
programme.desc: Max vil vinde en kvajevideo-konkurrence ved at sende en film ind af Phoebe, der øver sig i ballet. Da Phoebe opdager, hvad han har i sinde, nægter hun at samarbejde, og Max må tage alle midler i brug for at få de billeder, han har brug for.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Sidste Aften med Klikerne

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 21. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 20. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 19. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 18. december

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 17. december
programme.desc: Nu har Julemand 39 kun en uge til at finde familien Andersens julehemmelighed. Han ved, at Putte smuglæser julekataloger, og han har fundet nye oplysninger i hendes blodprøve.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 16. december
programme.desc: I sine undersøgelser af familien Andersens forsvundne jul, er Julemand 39 kommet på sporet af den førtidspensionerede Julemand 68, som på mystisk vis lever i sus og dus på Bahamas.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 15. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har sporet Julemand 68, den sidste julemand, der har været hos familien Andersen, til Bahamas. Notarius har lovet at skaffe oplysninger , der kan bringe 68 hjem. Putte er ikke den julejomfru

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 14. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har endnu ikke fundet afgørende spor i efterforskningen af familien Andersens julehemmelig­hed. Og der er nogen, der har fjernet vigtige oplys­nin­ger i juleannalerne.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 13. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor vil familien Andersen ikke fejre jul? Julemand 39 har nu kun 11 dage tilbage til at løse mysteriet, ellers degraderer Julemandsrådet ham til nisse. Julemand 39 har bedt Notarius om at hjælpe sig med at finde Julemand 68

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 12. december
programme.desc: Hvor mange hemmeligheder har familien Andersen egentlig? Julemand 39’s opgave bliver vanskeligere og vanskeligere. Moster Karen har hemmeligheder for hele familien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 11. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor har familien Andersen ikke fejret jul i 19 år - eller er det 20? Skal svaret findes i kælderen? Julemand 39’s assistent, Frits, opdager, at Tage Andersen - efter at familien er gået til ro - lister ned i kælderen og låser døren efter sig.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 10. december
programme.desc: Den intetanende familien Andersen har taget godt imod Frits, der er forklædt som Åses bror Klavs fra Australien. Familien har det godt - bortset fra Putte, som savner sin gas- og vandmester.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 9. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet er ved at miste tålmodigheden med Julemand 39. I endnu et forsøg på at løse gåden om Andersens julefjendskhed har 39 sendt Frits ned til familien forklædt som Åse Andersens lillebror, onkel Klavs fra Australien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 8. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har kun 17 dage tilbage til at afsløre familien Andersens hemmelighed og få Tage, Åse og Putte til at hengive sig til juleriet. Han har stadig ingen spor at gå efter.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 7. december
programme.desc: Det er en særdeles vanskelig opgave Julemand 39 har fået af Julemandsrådet. Nu ved han ikke en gang, om det et 19 eller 20 år siden, familien sidst holdt jul.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 6. december
programme.desc: For at undgå degradering til nisse, må Julemand 39 få den julefjendske familien Andersen til at fejre jul i år. Hans assistent, Frits, har fundet et spor i sagen - en musetrappe - men han har også forelsket sig stormende i husets datter Putte.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 5. december
programme.desc: Frits er vel ankommet til familien Andersens hjem. Han er allerede håbløst forelsket i datteren Putte, men det lykkes ham dog alligevel at finde et vigtigt spor i sagen - en musetrappe, som han tager med tilbage til Julemand 39.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: En kronik om det tragiske kærlighedsforhold mellem den amerikanske digter Elizabeth Bishop og den brasilianske arkitekt Lota de Macedo Soares.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Achilleskometen

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Jeg Elsker Deg, Slimbert

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: En Vandal I Nabolaget

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Du Stjal Drømman, Min
programme.desc: Når Max vinner skolevalget som Phoebe hadde kjempet så hardt for, planlegger Phoebe en hevn.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Thundersans
programme.desc: Phoebe får evnen til å sanse fare før det virkelig skjer, og bruker de nye instinktene sine for å imponere klassekameratene. Samtidig later Max som om han ikke har fått den nye sansen, så Barb skal kjøpe trøstegaver til ham.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Frostulerer Med Dagen
programme.desc: Phoebe og Max ønsker å feire bursdagene sine som normale tenåringer, men når en frossen Fru Wong forsvinner og de må finne henne, forstår de hvor bra familieselskapene deres virkelig er.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Opp, Opp Og Avsted På Ferie!

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Overnattingen

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jasper Danger

programme.title: Henry Danger: Steinen fra Verdensrommet

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tekniske Problemer

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mannebeistet Henry
programme.desc: Henry skal på et stort stevnemøte, men ting går ikke helt som planlagt etter at han tilfeldigvis blir eksponert for et merkelig apparat i Man-hulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad

programme.title: Henry Danger: Røverhistorie

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Livet og karrieren til den legendariske komikeren Andy Kaufman.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.desc: Jan er personskadeadvokat, men tar bare store saker der han kan inngå forlik utenfor rettssalen. Selv om hans nye sak først ser enkel ut, blir han snart innblandet i en episk kamp, som han er villig til å satse karrieren sin på.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Max Sine Minions

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Foreldre Forstår Ingenting

programme.title: Van Gogh At Eternity's Gate

programme.title: Biker Boyz
programme.desc: Smoke, ""Kongen av Cali"" - er den ubeseirede og overlegne racermesteren. Hans dominans og tittel blir utfordret av Kid, et ungt vindunderbarn, i en fengslede historie om moderne våghalser i det ultimate kappløp for å vinne den rasketes rett.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back forteller den sanne historien til syv fangers umulige plan om å flykte fra en sovjetisk fangeleir i 1941. Deres flukt til frihet tar dem på en reise gjennom verdens mest nådeløse landskap.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, og Justin Long serverer latter når unge servitører og servitriser søker etter meningen ved livet, kjærligheten, og vennskap i denne hysteriske komedien.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh er i trening for å bli en iskald internasjonal leiemorder, men i hemmelighet lengter hun etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
programme.desc: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programme.desc: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programme.desc: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Shelter
programme.desc: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programme.title: Le Mans

programme.title: Fantomet
programme.desc: Historien begynner når en ekspedisjon går i land på øya Bengalla på leting etter Tougandas hodeskaller. Med sin evne til å styre energi kan de bli en katastrofe for menneskeheten.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Book of Love

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Myth of the Maze
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Claudia besøker Athen, Hellas for å lete i Minotaurs labyrint etter den legendariske gylne hyssing.

programme.desc: Tyr krasjlander Eureka Maru på en Nietzschean-planet og utvikler hukommelsestap. Han må huske hva han gjør før Nietzscheans oppdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper mottar kunnskapsgaven fra en døende Perseid, bare for å oppdage at Perseid ble etterlyst av en dusørjeger som nå har vendt oppmerksomheten mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan blir arrestert for å ha myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.desc: Phoebe og Max gjør en enkel tur til senteret for å hente bursdagsgaven til Hank, om til krangling, kaos og et møte med sikkerhetsvaktene, noe som truer med å kjøre hele bursdagen til Hank i grøfta.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Feil Med Fail
programme.desc: Max forsøker å vinne en konkurranse ved å sende inn en "fail" film av Phoebe som øver på ballett. Når Phoebe finner ut av dette nekter hun å samarbeide med Max og Max blir desperat etter å få filmen han trenger.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Venners Venner
programme.desc: Phoebe og Max er redd de alltid må være sammen når vennene deres begynner å være sammen på fritiden. Tvillingene anstrenger seg for at en kinotur bli en dårlig opplevelse.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Hjemsøkte Thundermans Del 1
programme.desc: Etter en superskurk rømmer fra Åndeverdenen på Halloween, reiser Familien Thunderman til New Orleans for å bekjempe skurken sammen med familien Hathaway.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Hvem er Moren Din?
programme.desc: Max og Phoebe selger Barb sitt gamle superheltbelte til en Elektress-fan, og må få det tilbake før hun får vite om det.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Det Store Rotteracet
programme.desc: Max forvandler Billy til verdens raskeste rotte for å vinne et rotterace som han har med bandmedlemmene sine. Billy elsker å løpe i superfart og vil ikke forvandles tilbake til seg selv igjen.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Jul Med Familien Thunderman
programme.desc: Max er på sitt sureste på julaften, helt til Julespøkelsene fra fortiden, nåtiden og fremtiden kommer for å få ham i julestemning.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Ond, Ondere, Ondesen
programme.desc: Det er Romeo og Julie superheltromanse når en pensjonert superskurk som tilfeldigvis er Thundermans gamle fiende, flytter til Hiddenville og sønnen hans og Phoebe begynner å date.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rammende Rytmer
programme.desc: Når Dr. Minyak kommer tilbake, er Henry i fare når han skjønner at hans beste venn, Charlotte, er forvandlet til en slem, supersterk person som har som mål å fange Kid Danger og Captain Man.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Jenter: Del 1
programme.desc: Mens Captain Man forsøker å fange The Mad Granny, en bestemor som terroriserer Captain Man når han opptrer offentlig, blir Henry tvunget til å sjonglere mellom arbeidslivet og sitt romantiske liv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Jenter: Del 2
programme.desc: Planene til Henry for skoledansen 'The Meatball' kompliseres når han må møte opp som Kid Danger. Når skoledansen topper seg blir han tvunget til å ta en dramatisk avgjørelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry & Hakkespettene
programme.desc: Når basketball-treneren til Piper slutter, blir Henry den nye treneren. Mens han prøver å piske laget i form blir han utfordret av 'The league board' og deres uortodokse regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Man: På Ferie
programme.desc: Ray stoler på at Henry og Charlotte beskytter Swellview mens han er i brullup hos sin kusine. Problemer oppstår når de må ordne ting på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: The Time Jerker
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger og Captain Man sloss mot Time Bandit faller Kid Danger tilfeldigvis inn i tidsmaskinen til Time Bandit og opplever den samme dagen om og om igjen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Luksus Biff
programme.desc: Med en invitasjon til den beste restauranten i Swellview bestemmer Henry seg for å ta med seg sjefen sin, Ray. Det blir mer komplisert enn han forventet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sjalue Henry
programme.desc: Etter at Jasper blir hyllet som en lokal helt blir Henry sjalu for at Kid Danger blir takket og ikke ham selv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jul med Danger
programme.desc: Når Captain Man blir arrestert for tyveri blir han nødt til å tilbringe julen i fengsel. Henry og Charlotte må prøve å hjelpe Captain Man så han får en fin jul i fengselet.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: I denne latterlige komedieklassikeren som satte karrierene til den fantastiske rollebesetningen på kartet, legger to venner ut for å omskrive moderne forholdsregler fra Los Angeles til Las Vegas.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Richard Gere spiller Jack Sommersby, en mann som kommer hjem fra krigen for å gjenoppta livet sitt sju år etter at han ble antatt omkommet.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokaten MattMurdock er blind, menhans resterende firesanser er overmenneskeligskarpe. Omdagen representererMurdock de undertrykte,men om natten er hanDaredevil.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Når en klok svart hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles finner seg transportert tilbake til middelalderens England, leder han styrtingen av en ond konge og vinner hjertet til en protofeministisk kvinne.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er lei av forholdet til kjæresten Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), en mega-fan av musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Når en akustisk demo av Tucks 25 år gamle plate plutselig dukker opp, fører dette til et møte med uventede konsekvenser.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Bryan Mills og hans kone er i Istanbul når de blir bortført. Mannen som holder dem som gissel viser seg å være far til en av de mennene som tidligere kidnappet Mills datter, og under frigjøringen av datteren ble han drept.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
programme.desc: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.desc: Andromeda styres av en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfunn. Mens den først var vennlig, prøver dronen å tvinge skipet til å bli med i konsensus.

programme.title: Mutant X: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Jesse blir tauet inn i et dødelig undercover-oppdrag av sin fremmede far, som jobber mot Eckhart

programme.title: Mutant X: Altered Ego

programme.title: Mutant X: Lazarus Syndrome
programme.desc: Teamet møter en mutant som dreper andre mutanter ved å tappe energien og kan også komme tilbake til livet etter å ha blitt drept.

programme.desc: Emma gjenforenes med en gammel venninne som har telecyber-krefter. Gjenforeningen blir imidlertid farlig når Michelle prøver å overgi Emma til GSA.

programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter

programme.title: Andromeda: Dans av majflugor
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar döende människor från en drivkraft, men de förvandlas snart till zombies som styrs av en hivemind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelrik finns nu tre
programme.desc: Skapelsens motor kan skriva om universum enligt ägarens önskemål. Dylan, Beka och Trance måste få tag på den innan någon med mörka planer får tag på den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på
programme.desc: Ett svart hål slår ut Dylan och skickar honom till en alternativ verklighet med fru och barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Uknown
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Mutant X: Once Around
programme.desc: Teamet tar över för att skydda ett av åklagarens huvudvittnen vars liv har hotats före rättegången.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Tommy Hawk

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe tar jobb på en pizzarestaurang för att få råd att köpa den nya mePhonen, och var för sig försöker de imponera på chefen med egna idéer. När Max tar på sig en för stor beställning måste de samarbeta för att rädda sina jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Brott Efter Brott
programme.desc: Hank bildar en brottsbekämpningsförening i grannskapet när det börjar begås brott. Max tar på sig skulden för brotten för att dölja sin egen hemlighet, men Phoebe vet att han är oskyldig och det är upp till familjen att fånga den verkliga brottslingen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rymdstenen
programme.desc: Henry får problem när han råkar bära med sig en rymdsten hem i ryggsäcken. När den mystiska stenen visar sig vara något helt annat måste han be Kapten Man om hjälp för att bli av med den.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Oskyldigt Misstänkt
programme.desc: Henry blir anklagad för att ha knuffat ner Debbie från taket. Kapten Man lovar att försöka rentvå Henry så att han får komma på hennes födelsedagsfest.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kamp på alla Håll
programme.desc: En ny elev tar Henrys plats i basketlaget, men Henry misstänker att nykomlingen Shawn ljuger om sin ålder. Kapten Man behöver hjälp av en gammal vän och måste komma över gammalt groll.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vilddjuret Henry
programme.desc: Henry ska gå på en viktig dejt, men allt går inte som planerat eftersom han råkar springa på en konstig apparat i Man-grottan.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Osynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kapten Mans vän Brad, som av en olyckshändelse blev osynlig för några år sedan, kommer på besök. Men det dröjer inte länge innan våra hjältar börjar tröttna på honom.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Varning för Spoiler
programme.desc: Henry och Ray tampas med stadens nya skurk, den irriterande Spoilern. Piper gör allt hon kan, och lite till, för att få gå med i en populär Kapten Man-fanclub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vinnaren tar allt
programme.desc: Kapten Man ser till att Henry får vara med i sitt favoritprogram Lyckohjulet för att kunna undersöka en serie inbrott som verkar vara ihopkopplade med TV-programmet. Men det dröjer inte länge förrän Henry själv råkar ut för ett inbrott.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jordens Undergång
programme.desc: När en supervulkan djupt under Swellview börjar visa tecken på att få ett utbrott blir Henry och Ray övertygade om att världen kommer gå under. Piper är övertygad om att hon är glutenintolerant.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hjärtligt Galet
programme.desc: När tjejen som Henry gillar går på en träff med en annan kille på alla hjärtans dag, bygger Schwoz en android för att Henry ska kunna göra henne svartsjuk. Ray går på en otrevlig träff med en av Henrys lärare.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Ett par i kris försöker rädda sitt förhållande på en helgresa.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jaques (Brian Cox – THE BOURNE IDENTITY) äger en sjaskig bar, som fungerar som ett andra hem för en brokig skara professionella drinkare. Jaques själv är fast besluten att supa och röka sig till döds. När han möter den unge hemlöse Lucas…

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: Den tidigare TV-chefen från New York, Joanna Eberhart flyttar med familjen till samhället Stepford, Connecticut, men börjar förstå att Stepford är aningen för perfekt.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Jimmy Jayne har suttit i fängelse och är nu huvudmisstänkt för ett brutalt massmord i Hollywood och han skyr inga medel för att bevisa sin oskuld.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-experten Friar hittar en bomb med tryckkänslig utlösare under sin skrivbordsstol och en osynlig hackare tvingar honom att stjäla digitala medel på nätet – för annars kommer Friars dotter att föras bort.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.desc: Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policemen try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En mycket begåvad film som bland annat prisbelönats för Bästa regi i Cannes 1987. Damiel (Bruno Ganz) är en ensam ängel som strövar omkring på Berlins krigsmärkta gator och tröstar dödliga i nöd.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Mutant X: Den slutliga domen
programme.desc: En mystisk domstol finner Adam skyldig till att ha försökt dominera världen med sina supermutanter och dömer honom till döden, vilket skickar resten av teamet på ett uppdrag att rädda honom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inferno
programme.desc: Teamet är på spåren av en pyromanisk mutant som orsakar kaos, medan Shalimar tvingas lägga sin rädsla för eld åt sidan för att rädda Emma.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ett steg närmare
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att hålla Brennan okontrollerbar mutanta makter i schack när han sätter uppdraget att skydda en senators dotter i fara.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Löner av Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuriet 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserna uppfinner ett explosivt gåvoägg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney och Nigel till en karta som leder till Drakägget.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Herr Rätt
programme.desc: Sydney stöter på sitt ex Gray och åker på semester med honom till Bali, men när Derek Lloyd dyker upp och ber henne hitta Parvatis skål kan hon inte motstå det.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation

programme.title: Forbidden World [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Shark Lake
programme.desc: Action legend Dolph Lundgren goes head to head with a bloodthirsty shark that has a resort town under siege.

programme.title: A Boy And His Dog [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Vic is a libidinous 18-year-old traversing the post-apocalyptic desert of 2024, in the company of his telepathic dog, Blood. When the pair encounter an underground community, the leader's daughter, Quilla Holmes, seduces Vic into their fold, separating him from Blood, who's left to survive on his own. But once Vic discovers he's been lured there solely for mechanized procreation, he realizes he's doomed unless he can escape and rejoin Blood.

programme.title: Spiders 3D
programme.desc: A space shuttle crashes into a New York City subway tunnel, releasing a bloodthirsty army of mutated spiders.

programme.title: 100° Below Zero
programme.desc: When a chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe, the enormous ash cloud blocks out the sun, plunging the continent into a new ice age. An American couple must find their college-aged kids and get them out of Paris before it freezes over.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Itsy Bitsy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Based on the centuries old poem, a family moves into a secluded mansion where they soon find themselves being targeted by an entity taking the form of a giant spider.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Ticks
programme.desc: A group of teenagers on a wilderness retreat are unaware that the woods have become infested by mutated ticks.

programme.title: Tidal Wave: No Escape

programme.title: Megafault

programme.title: The Brain (1988) [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth

When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Deathsport [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ranger guides (David Carradine, Claudia Jennings) on horseback wield transparent swords against 30th-century motorcycle gladiators.

programme.title: Hybrid
programme.desc: When a young man is blinded in an explosion, he becomes the first human subject to undergo a cross-species transplant.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Hunters [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Retrograde

programme.title: Shark Attack

Upon arriving in the village, he meets Lawrence Rhodes (Ernie Hudson), a local hotel owner, and scientist Miles Craven (Bentley Mitchum), who informs Steven of the mysterious increase in shark attacks in the area. When Steven teams up with his late friend's sister for a fact-finding dive, they make a surprising discovery.

programme.desc: A story of a gunfighter who goes after a band of marauders that is terrorizing and killing indiscriminately.

programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

When the groups meet up, by mistake, they're left to discover if the motel is really abandoned and haunted by the souls, of the clowns, that once lived there...

programme.title: Demon Baby
programme.desc: A young couple looking to rekindle a damaged relationship retreat to the remote Scottish Highlands. They are haunted by their past, their surroundings and each other.

programme.title: Real Mann TV S3 Ep. 1 - We’re Back in Gorge-ous Colorado
programme.desc: Kyle Reyes returns in Colorado for ziplining, free falls, donuts and a new round of all-American thrills with special guests and plenty of adventure.
